tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research.

steps.what: Read actual undergraduate or graduate teaching plans, internship evidence and history research work before supervision
Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work through observation, discussion and corrective scholarly guidance
Write and check actual supervision feedback on the existing student work item in {LMS}
Post the checked supervision feedback to the designated student work item {LMS}

tasks.design: Keep actual student-work reading, supervision and scholarly feedback human. The existing {LMS} work item already carries student and assignment identity; no repeated administrative entry is established for a new tool to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on the actual student's work and understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work items already support the written follow-up.
tasks.still_hard: Guiding historical reasoning and responsible teaching or research practice.

ambition.what: No wider supervision span is promised.

evidence.claim: Native student work items can hold feedback, but scholarly supervision requires actual reading and contextual guidance.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual work review, live supervision and its written feedback, split out before zero. Grade decisions and formal placement administration belong to their actual tasks, with no saving credited here.

Students or placement staff supply actual work and evidence; the teacher reads it in s1 and produces specific feedback in s2-s3. Missing evidence is checked through the counted discussion; scheduled activity is not competence.

Native identity fields are already present. The digest's feedback-drafting option would still need source-grounded scholarly checking; no time benefit is assumed for this short specific supervision note. No system change means zero upkeep. Normal final check in s3 binds the exact feedback and student work item.
unknowns: Actual length and frequency of written supervision feedback.
research_questions: Is there repeated administration beyond the existing student work item?

already_counted.description: Student-work reading, supervision and actual feedback writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact feedback and designated student work item checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual reading, supervision, writing and posting remain; no grade automation or invented administrative baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform administrative duties as department head by identifying actual staffing, course, resource and departmental priorities
Discuss departmental priorities, staffing issues and resource trade-offs with colleagues and administration
Reconcile departmental budget and actual expenditure using native cost-code totals and explicit comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET}
Prepare the departmental course and duty allocation record in the academic planning system {OTHER}, using native conflict checks
Check the complete departmental record against actual availability, agreed duties, resource limits and intended internal recipients
Commit the checked departmental record in {OTHER}
Send the checked allocation record to the internal departmental recipients through {OTHER}

tasks.design: Configure native academic allocation conflicts in {OTHER} and budget comparisons from approved {ERP} exports in {SPREADSHEET}. The department head retains staffing and resource choices, discussions and final record checks before separate commit and internal send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departmental administration can require repeated cost reconciliation and allocation conflict checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Native academic planning and budget formulas can expose explicit conflicts and totals.
tasks.still_hard: Fair allocations and sensitive staffing or resource trade-offs.

ambition.what: No added employment or spending authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less administrative reconciliation, unchanged department-head responsibility.

reach.learn: Course requirements and agreed duty boundaries.

evidence.claim: Native academic allocation checks and explicit budget comparisons can support department administration without deciding staffing or fairness.

assumptions: The broad statement is illustrated by an actual department-head allocation cycle with budget reconciliation, not a claimed universal daily mix. Institutions without this cycle must estimate their own duties. No formal hiring, personnel rating or policy enactment is automated.

Faculty administration supplies course ID, actual enrollment need and timetable constraints; staff supply actual availability; finance supplies cost code, actual expenditure and approved budget. Missing data is manually reconciled within retained s3-s5 work. Existing capture by its producers is unchanged.

Native settings first. Only reconciliation arithmetic and conflict handling change; staffing judgement, discussion and final fairness checks remain. Access and employee consultation follow national rules. Normal final check in s5 binds the complete allocation and exact internal recipients; any edit voids both gates.
unknowns: Actual department-head duties and existing native planning configuration.
research_questions: Which repeated conflict and cost checks remain after native settings are enabled?

already_counted.description: Priorities, discussions and final departmental record checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain cost mappings and academic conflict settings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact departmental record checked in s5; edits require recheck.
Exact allocation and internal recipient set checked in s5; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 7 budget plus 7.5 allocation points less 1.5 upkeep for this allocation-cycle occurrence. Low is native settings already present or a different administrative duty mix.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic or administrative committees.

steps.what: Read the actual committee papers on institutional policies, departmental matters and academic issues
Serve on academic or administrative committees by deliberating, questioning evidence and making actual contributions to collective decisions
Write and check actual personal follow-up actions in the existing committee work item {PROJECT}
Save the checked personal action note in {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Keep committee paper reading and deliberation human, with the small personal action record in the existing {PROJECT} work item. Native agenda and work-item fields already exist, so no extra preparation or minutes-writing baseline is created for a new tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on understanding issues and contributing to deliberation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document and work-item tools already support ordinary committee work.
tasks.still_hard: Weighing policy, academic and institutional consequences.
tasks.human_edge: Independent academic judgement and collective deliberation.

ambition.what: No additional committee participation is assumed.

reach.learn: Distinguish a member's note from official minutes.

evidence.claim: Committee participation requires actual reading and deliberation; existing work items can hold small follow-up notes.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual committee participation and any existing personal action note. Official minutes are the recorder's task, not assumed to be written by every member. No report or send is hidden in deliberation.

The secretary supplies actual agenda and papers; committee discussion supplies actual assigned actions, captured by the teacher in s3. Missing or disputed assignments require clarification, not automated inference.
Native agenda and action fields already supply structure. No new system is introduced, so upkeep is zero. Ordinary author check in s3 binds the exact saved note without adding an approval ceremony.
unknowns: Whether this member has an actual personal follow-up note.
research_questions: Is any repeated administration present beyond the existing committee tools?

already_counted.description: Reading, deliberation and actual personal note writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact personal action note checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual reading, deliberation and the small explicit note and save remain; no new minutes-writing baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and history research issues.

steps.what: Read the actual teaching or history research issue and the colleague's relevant work
Collaborate with colleagues to address teaching and research issues through actual scholarly discussion and joint choices
Revise the shared teaching or research artefact in {DOCS} and check that the changes represent the actual joint choices
Save the checked revision in the existing shared {DOCS} workspace

tasks.design: Use the existing shared {DOCS} workspace for actual scholarly collaboration. Versioning already handles the ordinary save; the teacher still reads the issue, discusses it and makes substantive changes to the joint artefact.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is joint reasoning and meaningful revision rather than repeated transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shared documents already support the collaboration.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving scholarly disagreements and improving the teaching or research approach.

ambition.what: No extra research collaboration is promised.

reach.task: Make joint reasoning explicit in revisions

evidence.claim: Native shared documents support revision, while scholarly discussion and substantive content changes remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual discussion and its shared artefact revision, explicitly separate before zero. It does not duplicate an independently authored course or research paper; only this collaboration's revision is counted.

Colleagues supply actual issue and existing work; the teacher supplies changes based on actual discussion in s3. Missing agreement is clarified manually, never inferred from attendance or a transcript.

Native coauthoring is already the baseline. No invented file-transfer or summary-writing step is credited. No system change means zero upkeep. Normal author check in s3 binds the exact saved revision; no publication or external send is implied.
unknowns: Actual shared artefact and current coauthoring tools.
research_questions: Is any repeated handoff present beyond native shared-document revision?

already_counted.description: Reading, scholarly discussion and actual content revision remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact shared revision checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual reading, discussion, substantive revision and ordinary save remain; existing coauthoring is not a new labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native departmental checks while retaining teaching supervision and scholarly deliberation.
reach: Explain academic constraints to faculty administration.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher whose administrative tools leave academic and supervisory decisions with people.
